Nora (Partnerships): Quick question: partner wants to allow downloads for on-prem customers (air-gapped), while also listing hosted endpoints. Need a short policy: can we rehost + provide downloadable artifacts to customers? cc @Ethan (Legal)
Ethan (Legal): Short answer: possible but needs explicit download consent, export classification, and an indemnity clause for redistribution. Also track whether downstream customer is allowed to re-distribute.
Yara (Marketplace): UI implications: show a "Downloadable" tag and a tooltip with allowed uses ("for internal deployment only", "no sublicense").
Cole (Ops): Ops note: if downloads allowed, we must verify signed manifest + checksum and record who downloaded which bundle (audit log). Also require partner-supplied attestations for FIPS/KMS if requested.
Rina (SI): SI perspective: downloads are often required for locked environments. We also need a machine-readable `download_license` field: one of ["internal-only","resell-ok","restricted"] so we can automate gating.
Nora (Partnerships): Good. Ethan 1: can you draft a 2-3 line clause we can add to onboarding for downloads?
Ethan (Legal): Draft clause: "Supplier grants Redwood the limited right to distribute downloadable Model artifacts to end customers for internal deployment only, subject to Supplier's export controls and the Model manifest. Redistribution or sublicensing by end customers is prohibited unless Supplier explicitly permits via `download_license` = 'resell-ok'. Redwood will maintain download audit logs and will block downloads for regions flagged in export_classification."
Ethan (Legal): Note: If partner chooses 'resell-ok' we need indemnity and revenue-share terms.
Yara (Marketplace): For catalog UX: show both "Hosted" and "Downloadable" availability chips. When downloadable, show allowed `download_license` and `export_classification`. Provide a one-click request flow for partners to request approval for resell.
Cole (Ops): Add webhook: `download.requested` -> #partnerships for manual approval when `download_license` = 'resell-ok' or `export_classification` != 'unrestricted'. Also require partner cert signature on manifest.
Rina (SI): Technical note: downloadable tar should include `manifest.json`, `weights.sha256`, and `license.txt`. We should also accept `attestation.sig` signed by partner key.
Nora (Partnerships): OK action items: Ethan final clause by Wed; Yara UI tag + request flow mock by Thu; Cole implement audit + webhook prototype next week; Rina provide example tar layout.
PolicyBot: Governance note: auto-block downloads for regions where export_classification == 'restricted'. Event logged to partnership-ticket-10021.
Nora (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll add this to the onboarding checklist and ping partners we have pending.
